description: This file declares functions and types related to parsing and handling line range arguments for a source code processing or version control tool. It includes function prototypes for parsing range arguments, skipping range specifications, and a typedef for a callback function used to retrieve specific lines.

methods.name: parse_range_arg
methods.description: Parses a range argument string to determine start and end lines based on a callback, file path, and index state.

methods.name: skip_range_arg
methods.description: Skips past a range argument string to locate the filename in a -L option syntax.
